# How much Inheritance Tax will this estate pay?

> Free UK Inheritance Tax calculator for deaths from April 2025: £325,000 nil-rate band, £175,000 residence nil-rate band with the £2 million taper, transferred spouse allowances, charity gifts and the 36% rate. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
